display.purpose: State name on the welcome sheet; balanced wrap, preceded by the 1.25rem/700 'Welcome to' line.

count.purpose: Legend counts; tabular numerals; trailing 'of 51' at 0.8125rem/600 Green Dim.

title-sm.purpose: State name in the last-tapped strip.

body.purpose: Legend rows, hints, notes rows; emphasis via <strong> in Retro White.

body-sm.purpose: Strip hint, notes text, error copy.

label.purpose: Field labels and meta lines in Green Dim.

map-label.purpose: State abbreviations in SVG units: 22px phone, 15px from 700px, 13px from 1200px.

shadows.name: input-ring
shadows.purpose: Drawn inset border on white fields (login input, note textarea). Not an elevation; the system has no outer shadows.

shadows.name: sheet-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Scrim behind the welcome sheet dialog.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing; every transition and keyframe uses it.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Plaque color/transform, state fill and edge color, notes row hover.

motion.name: t-med
motion.purpose: Sheet rise (translateY 24px to 0, fade in), backdrop fade, map busy opacity.

motion.name: wipe
motion.purpose: Sheeting wipe: a white overlay clipped to the changed state.

motion.name: long-press
motion.purpose: Hold a state or exit tab to open the welcome sheet; Shift+Enter is the keyboard equivalent.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses the wipe and the sheet rise to instant swaps.

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a US highway sign seen from a dark road: Highway green guide signs for chrome, sign blanks for anything not yet lit, Interstate blue and Interstate red as the two people's colors, and flat retroreflective white for the one state that matters most, "both." The world is FHWA/MUTCD signage, not a dashboard: no stat cards, no paper-map pastels, no glow. Light comes from the sheeting (a solid fill and a white border line), never from the air around it.

Density is high and phone-first. Panels sit on the asphalt with 10px to 14px gutters, controls are rectangular plaques with 44px minimum height, and the map runs edge to edge. Everything that can be a sign is a sign: the legend, the last-tapped strip, the notes list, the welcome sheet, the login card, the exit tabs, even the state shapes themselves (a fill with an inset border line, exactly like the panels). One typeface in mixed case carries all copy; numerals are tabular everywhere.

Confirmed rejections: bloom and neon glow; shield shapes for the two person colors; imitations of any real state's welcome sign; glyph icon fonts and raster imagery (the build ships only authored SVG).
keyCharacteristics: Night asphalt ground with sign-green panels; depth is tonal, not shadowed.
One recurring anatomy: solid panel, inset 2px retroreflective border line, rounded corners.
Four marks, four flat fills: blank, Interstate blue, Interstate red, retroreflective white.
Highway yellow is reserved: the "Other phone" plaque, focus ring, caret, selection, accent-color.
Overpass only, weights 500 to 800, tabular numerals, tightened tracking above 1.25rem.
Motion is brief and literal: a 360ms sheeting wipe on change, a 220ms sheet rise, instant under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Colors-Only Rule
rules.body: Interstate blue and Interstate red are fills. No shield outlines, no route numbers, no badge silhouettes; the color is the whole reference.

rules.name: The Yellow Ration Rule
rules.body: Highway yellow appears for attention and focus only: the remote-change plaque, focus ring, caret, selection, accent-color. If a resting surface is yellow, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Both-Is-White Rule
rules.body: "Both" is flat retroreflective white with an Ink inset border. It is the brightest thing on the map by contrast alone; it gets no glow, gradient, or pattern.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Overpass at 500 to 800 is the entire type system. New surfaces pick a step from the ramp above; they do not add a serif, a mono, or a display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Numbers that can change (counts, character counters, relative times) inherit tabular numerals and never reflow their neighbors.

rules.name: The No-Bloom Rule
rules.body: No outer shadows, no blur, no halo on any surface or state. Light is a flat fill and a white line; focus is a hard 3px yellow outline at 3px offset.

dos: Do build every new container as a sign: solid fill, 10px radius, the 2px Retro Border line inset 6px via ::before.
Do make every control a plaque (6px radius, 44px minimum height, 1.5px inset line) and reserve the white plaque for the one primary action on a panel.
Do keep the four marks as flat fills (Sign Blank, Interstate Blue, Interstate Red, Retro White) with the matching inset line (Blank Border, Retro Border, Retro Border, Ink).
Do set all copy in Overpass 500 to 800, mixed case, with tabular numerals; tighten tracking at 1.25rem and above.
Do keep blanks legible on asphalt: Sign Blank fill with a Blank Border line, Blank Label text, checked at 390px.
Do use Highway Yellow for focus (3px outline, 3px offset) and remote-change attention only.
Do keep motion literal and short: 140ms ease-out for control states, 220ms for the sheet, 360ms for the sheeting wipe, and collapse all of it under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add bloom, neon glow, outer shadows, or blur to any state, panel, or control.
Don't draw Interstate shield shapes, route numbers, or badge silhouettes; blue and red are colors only.
Don't imitate a real state's welcome sign; the sheet is one generic template with the state name swapped in.
Don't fill a state, a panel, or a resting control with Highway Yellow.
Don't introduce a second typeface, icon fonts, or raster imagery; icons are authored stroke SVGs at 1em.
Don't use pills, circles, or cut corners for controls; the system is rounded rectangles with a following inner line.
